name: Luxury Chronograph Obsidian Black Watch
description: Crafted with surgical-grade stainless steel and sapphire crystal glass, this premium chronograph watch offers Japanese quartz movement, 50m water resistance, and an interchangeable genuine leather strap. Perfect for formal and everyday wear.
shortDescription: Surgical grade stainless steel chronograph with sapphire crystal.

name: Heavyweight Streetwear Essentials Black Hoodie
description: 450 GSM fleece hoodie built for ultimate warmth, comfort, and a relaxed boxy streetwear drape. Features pre-shrunk combed cotton, double-layered hood, and durable ribbed cuffs.
shortDescription: Premium 450 GSM ultra-heavyweight cotton fleece streetwear hoodie.

name: Bleu De Luxe Eau De Parfum (100ml)
description: An intense, woody aromatic fragrance that opens with fresh citrus zest, evolving into heart notes of dry cedar and pink pepper, anchored by rich sandalwood and amber.
shortDescription: Long-lasting woody aromatic fragrance with amber and citrus notes.

name: Urban Edge Air Retro High Sneakers
description: Iconic high-top silhouette crafted from genuine leather and suede accents. Features responsive air cushioning in the sole, padded collars for ankle support, and high-traction rubber outsole.
shortDescription: Classic high-top silhouette with responsive air cushioning.

name: Active ANC Wireless Noise Cancelling Earbuds
description: Immerse yourself in high-fidelity sound with 38dB Active Noise Cancellation, transparency mode, 40 hours of combined battery life, and IPX5 water resistance.

name: Classic Vintage Polarized Sunglasses
description: Timeless retro square frame designed with lightweight acetate and UV400 TAC polarized lenses that eliminate glare and deliver crystal-clear contrast.
shortDescription: UV400 polarized retro frames for everyday UV protection.

name: Minimalist Smart Fitness Band Tracker
description: Track your heart rate, SpO2, sleep stages, and over 50 sports modes on a bright AMOLED touch display. Boasts up to 14 days of battery life per charge.
shortDescription: AMOLED touch screen, 14-day battery and 50+ sport modes.

name: Tactical NY Embroidered Baseball Cap
description: Structured 6-panel cotton twill cap with high-density front 3D embroidery, breathable eyelets, and adjustable brass buckle strap.
shortDescription: Structured 6-panel cotton twill cap with 3D embroidery.
